traits.name: Thick Retreat
traits.description: The fiend takes half damage from opportunity attacks and its movement cannot be reduced by effects that require hitting it with an attack (such as sentinel).

traits.name: Wild Spirit
traits.description: The first attack roll or ability check the fiend makes each turn has advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fiend makes two Feral Strike attacks.

actions.name: Feral Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Gore Charge
actions.description: If the fiend moves at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a creature, it can make an attack against them with their tusks, as a Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage and, if they are no larger than one size category above the fiend, the target is knocked prone.

bonus_actions.name: Dash or Leap
bonus_actions.description: The fiend takes the Dash action, or it leaps up to half its movement speed (requiring no movement) to a space they can see.

bonus_actions.name: Flip
bonus_actions.description: If the fiend hits the same target with two Feral Strikes in the same turn, it can make a grapple attempt against them as a bonus action. If they succeed, the fiend can knock them prone and/or push them up to 10 feet in any direction.
